description: City Council will consider rezoning 608 Broadway Avenue.
Council will consider zoning bylaw amendments for 608 Broadway Avenue.
Council will consider rezoning Delainey Road and Nazarali Lane.
This includes amending the Brighton Neighbourhood concept plan.

chips.text: Residents in the Brighton Neighbourhood are potentially affected.
